Retaining Ring · U-Type

U-Type Retaining Ring

A radially-inserted retaining ring of the same family as the E-type and C-type, which grips a narrow groove on the shaft with a U-shaped hook structure. It can also be removed with a general tool such as a screwdriver, but once removed, it cannot be reused. Its specification symbol is denoted as UTW, based on our official specification sheet.
